msContents.summary: According to the descriptive catalogue, this manuscript breaks off at the 30th story.

lg.l: kathayantaṃ hitārtthānāṃ prabhāvānat_bhutās tathā |
romaśan dharmmatatvajñaṃ paryyapṛchśad yudhiṣṭhiraḥ |

yo ra
kṣat_ prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttharttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ |
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yat_ syāt tan me brūhi tapodhana ||

ekataḥ kratavas sarvve sa
magravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ |
atraivodāharantīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ |

indrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śibe
r auśīnarasya ca |
varttamāne mahāyajñe jijñāsārtthaṃ śibiṃ nṛpaṃ |
indraś śyenaḥ kapotāgniḥ bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ |

atha tan nṛpatiṃ prāpya kapo
taś śenajāt_ bhayāt |
śaraṇārtthī mahīpālan nililye bhayavihvalaḥ |
tataś śanair upāgamya śyenarūpī sureśvaraḥ |

rājānaṃ sumahā
prājñaṃ provācedaṃ vacas tadā |
dharmmātmānam ihaivāhur āhur ekaṃ rājan mahīkṣitaḥ |
satvan dharmmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karmma cikīrṣasi |

bhavān_ kṛtaghnaṃ
dānena satyenānṛtavādinaṃ |
kṣamaya krūrakarmmāṇam asādhu sādhunā jaye |
nopakārapare py evam upakārapare janaḥ |

apakārapare pi tvam u
pakarapare yathā |
mā hīṃsīr lobhato dharmmam dharmmam utsṛjya mānaśiḥ -
santrantrastarūpī trāṇārtthī mamno yo vihaṃgama |

mat_sakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇagṛ
dhnurayaṃ khagaḥ |
tad evam āgatasyāsya kapotasya bhayārtthinaḥ |
kathasmadvidhaḥ kuryyāt tyāgaṃ sat_bhir vvigarhitaṃ |
lobhād veṣāt_ bhayād vāpi yas tyajecharaṇāgataṃ |
brahmahatyāsaman tasya pāpam āhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

śāstreṣu niṣkṛtir ddṛṣṭā mahāpā
takinām api |
śaraṇātigatahantus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit |
yathātmanapriyāḥ prāṇās sarvveṣāṃ prāṇinān tathā |
tasmān mṛtyubhayatrastās trā prāṇino budhaiḥ |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhair nnityaṃ saṃsārasāgare |
jīntavaḥ parikliśyante mṛtyos trasyānti te tataḥ |
yannimittach śānuch śākas trāso vā krodha eva vā |
āyāso vā yato mūlam ekaṃgam api santyajet |
mariṣyāmīti yad duḥkhaṃ punar asyopajāyate |

jñeyas tasyānumānena paro pi parirakṣituṃ
|
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītaṃ prāpayiṣye kapotakaṃ
yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvitaṃ priyaṃ |

saṃrakṣate jīvitam ā
tmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ |
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītaṃ prāpayiṣye kapotakaṃ |
yad atra yuktam anyan te vaktuṃ śyenāsu tad vada |
āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti janeśvara |
āhārāt_ sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti janeśvara |
āhāreṇai rddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ |
śakyate duṣkaro py artthe cirarātrāya jīvituṃ |
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ varttayituṃ kvacit |
tasmād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā viśāṃpate |

visṛjya kā
yaṃ yāsyānti panthānam apunarbhavaṃ |
mṛte mayi ca sarvvam me putradāram mariśyati |
rakṣyamāṇaḥ kapotatvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇān_ hariṣati |

dharmmaṃ yo bādhate dharmmo
na sa dharmmaḥ parantapa |
avirodhiti yo dharmmas sa dharmmas sat_bhir ucyate |
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya sañcintya gurulāghavaṃ |

yato bhūyās tato rājan_ kuru dharmmavi
nirṇṇayaṃ |
nāto bhūyastaro dharmmo kaścid anyo sti khecara |
prāṇināṃ | bhayabhītānām abhayaṃ | yat_ pradīyate |

varam ekasya satvasya pradatta|
ñ jīvitābhayaṃ |
na ca viprasahasrebhyo gosahasran dine dine |
abhayaṃ | sarvvabhūtebhyo yo dadāti dayā paraḥ |

tasya dehād vimuktasya kṣaya e
va na vidyate |
hemadhenudhanādīnā dātāras sula|bhā bhuvi |
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvvabhūtadayāparaḥ |

mahatām ahatāpy ayajñānāṃ kālena kṣī
yate phalaṃ |
bhītābhayapradānasya kṣayam asya na vidyate |
dattam iṣṭan tapas taptaṃ tīrtthaṃ vedāśritan tathā

sarvvāṇy abhayadānasya kalān nārhanti ṣo
ḍaśīṃ |
catussāssāgaraparyyantāṃ yo dadyāt_ pṛthivīm imāṃ |
abhayaṃ sarvvasarvvabhūtebhyo tato bhayarato dhikaḥ |

api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā su
dustyajaṃ |
na tv adyaā na bhayasantrastaṃ santyakṣye yaṃ kapotakaṃ |
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kincis tena janmani janmani |
bhaye trātā bhayārttānām ārttināva dehināṃ |

na tv ahaṅ kāma
ye rājyaṃ na svargaṃ vā nāpunarbhavam |
prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāmaye duḥkhanāśanaṃ |
yathā ca nānṛtāṃ vācaṃ aham edāhare

satyenānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu|
maheśvaraḥ |
āhārārtthe samāraṃbhas tava cāhaṃ vihaṃgama |
tad yatheṣṭan tavāhāraṃ anyad deva dadāmy ahaṃ |

sa eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapo
takaḥ |
tam evot_jya nāhāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mmama |
śyenākāḥ kapotā khādanti śrutir eṣā sanātanī |

mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadaḷīstaṃ
bam āruha |
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |
śāstrair evopradiṣṭo yaṃ dharmmas satvadayāparaḥ |

sarvvasatveṣu yad dā
nam ekasatvae ca yā paraḥdayā |
sarvvasatvapradānāc ca dayaikasmin viśiṣyate |
sarvve vedā na tat_ kuryyus sarvve yajñāś ca khecara |

sarvvatīrtthābhi
ṣekaś ca yat_ kuryyāt_ prāṇinān dayā |
vāṅ_manaḥkarmmakāyair ye sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |
dayādarśitapanthāno brahmalokaṃ vrajanti te |

gachśatas tiṣṭhato vāpi
jāgrata svapato pi vā |
yan na bhūtahitārtthāya tat_ paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ |
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtaāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ |

ātmavanti parirakṣanti te yānti pa
ramāṃ gatiṃ |
prāṇinaṃ vadhyamānan tu yaś śaktus samupekṣato |
sa yāti nakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur mmanīṣiṇaḥ |

rājyaṃ śibīnāṃ sumahat_ praya
chśāmi tava dvija |
yad vā kāmase hy anyat_ varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ |
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā bhaktir īdṛśī |

kapotena tu tulyāni sva
māṃsāni prayachśa me |
anugraham imam manye yasyan māṃ śyenābhiyācase |
etat te haṃ prayachśāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvaid ichśasi |

yad apriyan tat_ sujanaś cirād va
datu vānavā |
mama tu priyam etad vai kasmād abhihitan cirāt |
addhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā |

dhruvaṃ yo nārjayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhace
tanaḥ |
yadi praṇyupakāro yaṃ deho yan nopabhujyate |
tataḥ kim upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā |

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce tava māṃsa
ñ janeśvarāa |
tasmāt_ kapotena dhṛtaṃ prayachśatu tulayā samaṃ |
tad evāhaṃ kariṣyāmi yadvaṃ śyenābhiyācase |
yenāsya tekṣun māṃsena tad vā tava vihaṃgama |
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samut_kṛtya sa pārtthivaḥ |
prahṛṣṭas tulayā māṃsaṃ kapotena saha prabhuḥ |
tyaktvātmasukhāgechśā sarvvasatvasukhaiṣaṇaḥ |

bhavanti pa
raduḥkhena sādhavas satyaduḥkhitāḥ |
dhrīyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatir ucyate |
punaś cot_kṛtya māṃsani tataḥ prādāt_ sa pārtthivaḥ |

na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ ka
potena samaṃ kvacit |
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sāv ārūroha tulāṃ svayaṃ |
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvvabhūtahite ratāḥ |

nāpekṣante mahātmānas sukhāni ca mahā
nty api
atha tasmimn_ samārūḍhe tulāmūlatare nṛpe
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ha |
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmmarājñe dhṛtiṃ parāṃ |

śākra sva
rūpam āsthāya vākyam etad abhāṣata |
indro ham asmi bhadran te kapoto havyavārddhayaḥ |
jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājann imaṃ yājñam upāgatau

naitat_ pūrvve
nṛpāś cakrur nna kariṣyanti cāpare |
mahākāruṇikeneha yat_ kṛtan duṣkṛtan tvayā |
parārtthe tyajataḥ prāṇān_ yā prītir abhavat tadā |

prāṇasaṃśayalubdhe
ṣu na sā prāneṣu dehināṃ |
parārtthaikāntakalyāṇīṃ svāśrayātyantaniṣṭhurāṃ |
paryyeva kevalaṃ rājan_ kuruṣe karuṇāpadaṃ |
svakarmmapāśais sudṛḍhair baddhaṃ kṛt_snam idaṃ jagat |
tvañ jagaddduḥkhamokṣārtthaṃ baddhaḥ karuṇayā nṛpā |
tathā sarvvātmanā cāpi doṣeṣu prahṛtā tvayā |

yathā
caivātmanā sthāne vaśīnāpi na śoṣitā |
akṛtvairṣyaṃ viśiṣṭeṣu hīnānāṃ nāvamatya ca
anuktvā sadṛśai sparddhān tvaṃ lokottamatāṃ gataḥ |

ātmaprāṇaiḥ pa
raprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati |
tad yāti sa paraddhāma yato nāvarttate punaḥ |

prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣaṇā kṛpaṇo
janaḥ |
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā |
paśavo pi hi jīvanti kevalātmodaraṃbhaḥrāḥ |

sa punar jjīvati ślāghyo yaḥ parā
rtthaṃ hi jīvati |
kiṃ cātra citraṃ yat santaḥ parānugrahatat_parāḥ |
na hi svadehaśaityāya jāyante cadaṇadrumāḥ |

paropakāranirato paro yaḥ pu
ruṣas sadā |
sa padaṃ paramāpnoti parād api ca yat_ paraṃ |
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukhāya gataspṛhāḥ |

jagaddhitāya jāyante sādhavas tu
dṛśo bhuvi |
yat te māṃsāni dhātrebhyas samut_kṛttāni ca pārtthivāa |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir llokān anu gamiṣyati —

divyarūpadharaś caiva pālaya
tva ca medinīṃ |
sarvvān_ lokān atikramya brahmaloke gamiti |
evam uktvā tam indrāya jagmatus tridaśālayaṃ |

rājā ca kṛtum iṣṭvāsau mumude deva
vat ciraṃ |
idaṃ śruṇeyān nityaṃ śibeś caritam uttamaṃ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prayāti tridivan naraḥ |

vimucya rājasvaśarīram addhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśas sarvvajanasya
durllabhaṃ |
śarīradānāt_ parajīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrattrayabhūṣaṇaṃ yayau |
